name: UKMOD Country Report 2023-2030 (version B2026.01)

model.name: UKMOD B2026.01
model.method: Static tax-benefit microsimulation on the EUROMOD platform, FRS input data (2023/24 base with HBAI-adjusted weights and incomes), uprated and projected to 2030 on official forecasts. Baseline applies approximate non-take-up corrections for means-tested benefits; take-up probabilities outside Scotland/pension-age have not been updated since 2021 (the report's own health warning).
model.method_basis: UKMOD Country Report 2023-2030, sections 3-4 and 4.3 health warnings

period: Policy years 2023-2030 (forecasts from 2025); reference input-data and HBAI columns for 2023
geographies: UK (devolved income tax rows are jurisdiction-specific by construction)
variant_note: variant distinguishes claim provenance: 'ukmod' (simulated), 'official_as_cited' (the report's transcription of DWP/HMRC/OBR/SFC estimates — cite the primary source, not this report, before scoring against them), 'input_data' (un-simulated FRS/HBAI input), 'hbai' (DWP HBAI as cited).
coverage_note: This build emits validation tables 4.5 (caseloads), 4.6 (expenditure), 4.7 (income distribution) and 4.8 (poverty rates). Earlier tables are policy-parameter documentation, not statistics. The Annex 6.6 FRS-only variant tables are not emitted.
diagnosis_upstream: UKMOD is open source (microsimulation.ac.uk/ukmod); divergence diagnoses classified as external-model issues can, uniquely among UK sources, become upstream reports to the UKMOD team.
